μααθ.def: probably of Hebrew origin; Maath, an Israelite. KJV: Maath.

μαγδαλα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H4026); the tower; Magdala (i.e. Migdala), a place in Palestine. KJV: Magdala.

μαγδαληνη.def: feminine of a derivative of Μαγδαλά (G3093); a female Magdalene, i.e. inhabitant of Magdala. KJV: Magdalene.

μαγευω.def: from μάγος (G3097); to practice magic. KJV: use sorcery.

μαγοσ.def: of foreign origin (H7248); a Magian, i.e. Oriental scientist; by implication, a magician. KJV: sorcerer, wise man.

μαγωγ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4031); Magog, a foreign nation, i.e. (figuratively) an Antichristian party. KJV: Magog.

μαδιαν.def: of Hebrew origin (H4080); Madian (i.e. Midian), a region of Arabia. KJV: Madian.

μαθητευω.def: from μαθητής (G3101); intransitively, to become a pupil; transitively, to disciple, i.e. enrol as scholar. KJV: be disciple, instruct, teach.

μαθητησ.def: from μανθάνω (G3129); a learner, i.e. pupil. KJV: disciple.

μαθητρια.def: feminine from μαθητής (G3101); a female pupil. KJV: disciple.

μαθουσαλα.def: of Hebrew origin (H4968); Mathusala (i.e. Methushelach), an antediluvian. KJV: Mathusala.

μαιναν.def: probably of Hebrew origin; Mainan, an Israelite. KJV: Mainan.

μαινομαι.def: middle voice from a primary μάω (to long for; through the idea of insensate craving); to rave as a "maniac". KJV: be beside self (mad).

μακαριζω.def: from μακάριος (G3107); to beatify, i.e. pronounce (or esteem) fortunate. KJV: call blessed, count happy.

μακαριοσ.def: a prolonged form of the poetical μάκαρ (meaning the same); supremely blest; by extension, fortunate, well off. KJV: blessed, happy(X -ier).

μακαρισμοσ.def: from μακαρίζω (G3106); beatification, i.e. attribution of good fortune. KJV: blessedness.

μακεδονια.def: from Μακεδών (G3110); Macedonia, a region of Greece. KJV: Macedonia.

μακεδων.def: of uncertain derivation; a Macedon (Macedonian), i.e. inhabitant of Macedonia. KJV: of Macedonia, Macedonian.

μακελλον.def: of Latin origin (macellum); a butcher's stall, meat market or provision-shop. KJV: shambles.

μακραν.def: feminine accusative case singular of μακρός (G3117) (ὁδός (G3598) being implied); at a distance (literally or figuratively). KJV: (a-)far (off), good (great) way off.

μακροθεν.def: adverb from μακρός (G3117); from a distance or afar. KJV: afar off, from far.

μακροθυμεω.def: from the same as μακροθυμώς (G3116); to be long-spirited, i.e. (objectively) forbearing or (subjectively) patient. KJV: bear (suffer) long, be longsuffering, have (long) patience, be patient, patiently endure.

μακροθυμια.def: from the same as μακροθυμώς (G3116); longanimity, i.e. (objectively) forbearance or (subjectively) fortitude. KJV: longsuffering, patience.

μακροθυμωσ.def: adverb of a compound of μακρός (G3117) and θυμός (G2372); with long (enduring) temper, i.e. leniently. KJV: patiently.

μακροσ.def: from μῆκος (G3372); long (in place (distant) or time (neuter plural)). KJV: far, long.

μακροχρονιοσ.def: from μακρός (G3117) and χρόνος (G5550); long-timed, i.e. long-lived. KJV: live long.

μαλακια.def: from μαλακός (G3120); softness, i.e. enervation (debility). KJV: disease.

μαλακοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; soft, i.e. fine (clothing); figuratively, a catamite. KJV: effeminate, soft.

μαλελεηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4111); Maleleel (i.e. Mahalalel), an antediluvian. KJV: Maleleel.

μαλιστα.def: neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb μάλα (very); (adverbially) most (in the greatest degree) or particularly. KJV: chiefly, most of all, (e-)specially.

μαλλον.def: neuter of the comparative of the same as μάλιστα (G3122); (adverbially) more (in a greater degree)) or rather. KJV: + better, X far, (the) more (and more), (so) much (the more), rather.

μαλχοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4429); Malchus, an Israelite. KJV: Malchus.

μαμμη.def: of natural origin ("mammy"); a grandmother. KJV: grandmother.

μαμμωνασ.def: of Chaldee origin (confidence, i.e. wealth, personified); mammonas, i.e. avarice (deified). KJV: mammon.

μαναην.def: of uncertain origin; Manaën, a Christian. KJV: Manaen.

μανασσησ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4519); Mannasses (i.e. Menashsheh), an Israelite. KJV: Manasses.

μανθανω.def: prolongation from a primary verb, another form of which, μαθέω, is used as an alternate in certain tenses; to learn (in any way). KJV: learn, understand.

μανια.def: from μαίνομαι (G3105); craziness. KJV: (+ make) X mad.

μαννα.def: of Hebrew origin (H4478); manna (i.e. man), an edible gum. KJV: manna.

μαντευομαι.def: from a derivative of μαίνομαι (G3105) (meaning a prophet, as supposed to rave through inspiration); to divine, i.e. utter spells (under pretense of foretelling. KJV: by soothsaying.

μαραινω.def: of uncertain affinity; to extinguish (as fire), i.e. (figuratively and passively) to pass away. KJV: fade away.

μαραναθα.def: of Chaldee origin (meaning our Lord has come); maranatha, i.e. an exclamation of the approaching divine judgment. KJV: Maran-atha.

μαργαριτησ.def: from μάργαρος (a pearl-oyster); a pearl. KJV: pearl.

μαρθα.def: probably of Chaldee origin (meaning mistress); Martha, a Christian woman. KJV: Martha.

μαρια.def: of Hebrew origin (H4813); Maria or Mariam (i.e. Mirjam), the name of six Christian females. KJV: Mary.

μαρκοσ.def: of Latin origin; Marcus, a Christian. KJV: Marcus, Mark.

μαρμαροσ.def: from μαρμαίρω (to glisten); marble (as sparkling white). KJV: marble.

μαρτυρεω.def: from μάρτυς (G3144); to be a witness, i.e. testify (literally or figuratively). KJV: charge, give (evidence), bear record, have (obtain, of) good (honest) report, be well reported of, testify, give (have) testimony, (be, bear, give, obtain) witness.

μαρτυρια.def: from μάρτυς (G3144); evidence given (judicially or genitive case). KJV: record, report, testimony, witness.

μαρτυριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of μάρτυς (G3144); something evidential, i.e. (genitive case) evidence given or (specially), the Decalogue (in the sacred Tabernacle). KJV: to be testified, testimony, witness.

μαρτυρομαι.def: middle voice from μάρτυς (G3144); to be adduced as a witness, i.e. (figuratively) to obtest (in affirmation or exhortation). KJV: take to record, testify.

μαρτυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a witness (literally (judicially) or figuratively (genitive case)); by analogy, a "martyr". KJV: martyr, record, witness.

μασσαομαι.def: from a primary μάσσω (to handle or squeeze); to chew. KJV: gnaw.

μαστιγοω.def: from μάστιξ (G3148); to flog (literally or figuratively). KJV: scourge.

μαστιζω.def: from μαστός (G3149); to whip (literally). KJV: scourge.

μαστιξ.def: probably from the base of μασσάομαι (G3145) (through the idea of contact); a whip (literally, the Roman flagellum for criminals; figuratively, a disease). KJV: plague, scourging.

μαστοσ.def: from the base of μασσάομαι (G3145); a (properly, female) breast (as if kneaded up). KJV: pap.

ματαιολογια.def: from ματαιολόγος (G3151); random talk, i.e. babble. KJV: vain jangling.

ματαιολογοσ.def: from μάταιος (G3152) and λέγω (G3004); an idle (i.e. senseless or mischievous) talker, i.e. a wrangler. KJV: vain talker.

ματαιοσ.def: from the base of μάτην (G3155); empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or (specially), an idol. KJV: vain, vanity.

ματαιοτησ.def: from μάταιος (G3152); inutility; figuratively, transientness; morally, depravity. KJV: vanity.

ματαιοω.def: from μάταιος (G3152); to render (passively, become) foolish, i.e. (morally) wicked or (specially), idolatrous. KJV: become vain.

ματην.def: accusative case of a derivative of the base of μασσάομαι (G3145) (through the idea of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of punishment); folly, i.e. (adverbially) to no purpose. KJV: in vain.

ματθαιοσ.def: a shorter form of μάχομαι (G3164); Matthæus (i.e. Matthitjah), an Israelite and a Christian. KJV: Matthew.

ματθαν.def: of Hebrew origin (H4977); Matthan (i.e. Mattan), an Israelite. KJV: Matthan.

ματθατ.def: probably a shortened form of Ματταθίας (G3161); Matthat (i.e. Mattithjah), the name of two Israelites. KJV: Mathat.

ματθιασ.def: apparently a shortened form of Ματταθίας (G3161); Matthias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite. KJV: Matthias.

ματταθα.def: probably a shortened form of Ματταθίας (G3161) (compare σωτήριον (G4992)); Mattatha (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite. KJV: Mattatha.

ματταθιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4993); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian. KJV: Mattathias.

μαχαιρα.def: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of μάχη (G3163); a knife, i.e. dirk; figuratively, war, judicial punishment. KJV: sword.

μαχη.def: from μάχομαι (G3164); a battle, i.e. (figuratively) controversy. KJV: fighting, strive, striving.

μαχομαι.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to war, i.e. (figuratively) to quarrel, dispute. KJV: fight, strive.

με.def: a shorter (and probably original) form of ἐμέ (G1691); me. KJV: I, me, my.

μεγαλαυχεω.def: from a compound of μέγας (G3173) and αὐχέω (to boast; akin to αὐξάνω (G837) and καυχάομαι (G2744)); to talk big, i.e. be grandiloquent (arrogant, egotistic). KJV: boast great things.

μεγαλειοσ.def: from μέγας (G3173); magnificent, i.e. (neuter, plural as noun) a conspicuous favor, or (subjectively) perfection. KJV: great things, wonderful works.

μεγαλειοτησ.def: from μεγαλεῖος (G3167); superbness, i.e. glory or splendor. KJV: magnificence, majesty, mighty power.

μεγαλοπρεπησ.def: from μέγας (G3173) and πρέπω (G4241); befitting greatness or magnificence (majestic). KJV: excellent.

μεγαλυνω.def: from μέγας (G3173); to make (or declare) great, i.e. increase or (figuratively) extol. KJV: enlarge, magnify, shew great.

μεγαλωσ.def: adverb from μέγας (G3173); much. KJV: greatly.

μεγαλωσυνη.def: from μέγας (G3173); greatness, i.e. (figuratively) divinity (often God himself). KJV: majesty.

μεγασ.def: (including the prolonged forms, feminine μεγάλη, plural μεγάλοι, etc.; compare also μέγιστος (G3176), μείζων (G3187)); big (literally or figuratively, in a very wide application). KJV: (+ fear) exceedingly, great(-est), high, large, loud, mighty, + (be) sore (afraid), strong, X to years.

μεγιστανεσ.def: plural from μέγιστος (G3176); grandees. KJV: great men, lords.

μεγιστοσ.def: superlative of μέγας (G3173); greatest or very great. KJV: exceeding great.

μεθερμηνευω.def: from μετά (G3326) and ἑρμηνεύω (G2059); to explain over, i.e. translate. KJV: (by) interpret(-ation).

μεθη.def: apparently a primary word; an intoxicant, i.e. (by implication) intoxication. KJV: drunkenness.

μεθιστημι.def: from μετά (G3326) and ἵστημι (G2476); to transfer, i.e. carry away, depose or (figuratively) exchange, seduce. KJV: put out, remove, translate, turn away.

μεθοδεια.def: from a compound of μετά (G3326) and ὁδεύω (G3593) (compare "method"); travelling over, i.e. travesty (trickery). KJV: wile, lie in wait.

μεθοριοσ.def: from μετά (G3326) and ὅριον (G3725); bounded alongside, i.e. contiguous (neuter plural as noun, frontier). KJV: border.

μεθυσκω.def: a prolonged (transitive) form of μεθύω (G3184); to intoxicate. KJV: be drunk(-en).

μεθυσοσ.def: from μεθύω (G3184); tipsy, i.e. (as noun) a sot. KJV: drunkard.

μεθυω.def: from another form of μέθη (G3178); to drink to intoxication, i.e. get drunk. KJV: drink well, make (be) drunk(-en).

μειζον.def: neuter of μείζων (G3187); (adverbially) in greater degree. KJV: the more.

μειζοτεροσ.def: continued comparative of μείζων (G3187); still larger (figuratively). KJV: greater.

μειζων.def: irregular comparative of μέγας (G3173); larger (literally or figuratively, specially, in age). KJV: elder, greater(-est), more.

μελαν.def: neuter of μέλας (G3189) as noun; ink. KJV: ink.

μελασ.def: apparently a primary word; black. KJV: black.

μελεασ.def: of uncertain origin; Meleas, an Israelite. KJV: Meleas.

μελεταω.def: from a presumed derivative of μέλω (G3199); to take care of, i.e. (by implication) revolve in the mind. KJV: imagine, (pre-)meditate.

μελι.def: apparently a primary word; honey. KJV: honey.

μελισσιοσ.def: from μέλι (G3192); relating to honey, i.e. bee (comb). KJV: honeycomb.

μελιτη.def: of uncertain origin; Melita, an island in the Mediterranean. KJV: Melita.

μελλω.def: a strengthened form of μέλω (G3199) (through the idea of expectation); to intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity, probability, possibility, or hesitation). KJV: about, after that, be (almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend, was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall (begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry, which was for, will, would, be yet.

μελοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a limb or part of the body. KJV: member.

μελχι.def: of Hebrew origin (H4428 with pronominal suffix, my king); Melchi (i.e. Malki), the name of two Israelites. KJV: Melchi.

μελχισεδεκ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4442); Melchisedek (i.e. Malkitsedek), a patriarch. KJV: Melchisedec.

μελω.def: a primary verb; to be of interest to, i.e. to concern (only third person singular present indicative used impersonally, it matters). KJV: (take) care.

μεμβρανα.def: of Latin origin ("membrane"); a (written) sheep-skin. KJV: parchment.

μεμφομαι.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to blame. KJV: find fault.

μεμψιμοιροσ.def: from a presumed derivative of μέμφομαι (G3201) and μοῖρα (fate; akin to the base of μέρος (G3313)); blaming fate, i.e. querulous (discontented). KJV: complainer.

μεν.def: a primary particle; properly, indicative of affirmation or concession (in fact); usually followed by a contrasted clause with δέ (G1161) (this one, the former, etc.). KJV: even, indeed, so, some, truly, verily.

μενουνγε.def: from (G3203) and οὖν (G3767) and γέ (G1065); so then at least. KJV: nay but, yea doubtless (rather, verily).

μεντοι.def: from (G3203) and τοί (G5104); indeed though, i.e. however. KJV: also, but, howbeit, nevertheless, yet.

μενω.def: a primary verb; to stay (in a given place, state, relation or expectancy). KJV: abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain, stand, tarry (for), X thine own.

μεριζω.def: from μέρος (G3313); to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ. KJV: deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give participle

μεριμνα.def: from μερίζω (G3307) (through the idea of distraction); solicitude. KJV: care.

μεριμναω.def: from μέριμνα (G3308); to be anxious about. KJV: (be, have) care(-ful), take thought.

μερισ.def: feminine of μέρος (G3313); a portion, i.e. province, share or (abstractly) participation. KJV: part (X -akers).

μερισμοσ.def: from μερίζω (G3307); a separation or distribution. KJV: dividing asunder, gift.

μεριστησ.def: from μερίζω (G3307); an apportioner (administrator). KJV: divider.

μεροσ.def: from an obsolete but more primary form of μείρομαι (to get as a section or allotment); a division or share (literally or figuratively, in a wide application). KJV: behalf, course, coast, craft, particular (+ -ly), part (+ -ly), piece, portion, respect, side, some sort(-what).

μεσημβρια.def: from μέσος (G3319) and ἡμέρα (G2250); midday; by implication, the south. KJV: noon, south.

μεσιτευω.def: from μεσίτης (G3316); to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety). KJV: confirm.

μεσιτησ.def: from μέσος (G3319); a go-between, i.e. (simply) an internunciator, or (by implication) a reconciler (intercessor). KJV: mediator.

μεσονυκτιον.def: neuter of compound of μέσος (G3319) and νύξ (G3571); midnight (especially as a watch). KJV: midnight.

μεσοποταμια.def: from μέσος (G3319) and ποταμός (G4215); Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare 0763), a region of Asia. KJV: Mesopotamia.

μεσοσ.def: from μετά (G3326); middle (as an adjective or (neuter) noun). KJV: among, X before them, between, + forth, mid(-day, -night), midst, way.

μεσοτοιχον.def: from μέσος (G3319) and τοῖχος (G5109); a partition (figuratively). KJV: middle wall.

μεσουρανημα.def: from a presumed compound of μέσος (G3319) and οὐρανός (G3772); mid-sky. KJV: midst of heaven.

μεσοω.def: from μέσος (G3319); to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way over. KJV: be about the midst.

μεσσιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4899); the Messias (i.e. Mashiach), or Christ. KJV: Messias.

μεστοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; replete (literally or figuratively). KJV: full.

μεστοω.def: from μεστός (G3324); to replenish, i.e. (by implication) to intoxicate. KJV: fill.

μετα.def: a primary preposition (often used adverbially); properly, denoting accompaniment; "amid" (local or causal); modified variously according to the case (genitive association, or accusative succession) with which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between ἀπό (G575) or ἐκ (G1537) and εἰς (G1519) or πρός (G4314); less intimate than ἐν (G1722) and less close than σύν (G4862)). KJV: after(-ward), X that he again, against, among, X and, + follow, hence, hereafter, in, of, (up-)on, + our, X and setting, since, (un-)to, + together, when, with (+ -out).

μεταβαινω.def: from μετά (G3326) and the base of βάσις (G939); to change place. KJV: depart, go, pass, remove.

μεταβαλλω.def: from μετά (G3326) and βάλλω (G906); to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to turn about in opinion. KJV: change mind.

μεταγω.def: from μετά (G3326) and ἁρμόζω (G718); to lead over, i.e. transfer (direct). KJV: turn about.

μεταδιδωμι.def: from μετά (G3326) and δίδωμι (G1325); to give over, i.e. share. KJV: give, impart.

μεταθεσισ.def: from μετατίθημι (G3346); transposition, i.e. transferral (to heaven), disestablishment (of a law). KJV: change, removing, translation.

μεταιρω.def: from μετά (G3326) and αἴρω (G142); to betake oneself, i.e. remove (locally). KJV: depart.

μετακαλεω.def: from μετά (G3326) and καλέω (G2564); to call elsewhere, i.e. summon. KJV: call (for, hither).

μετακινεω.def: from μετά (G3326) and κινέω (G2795); to stir to a place elsewhere, i.e. remove (figuratively). KJV: move away.

μεταλαμβανω.def: from μετά (G3326) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to participate; genitive case, to accept (and use). KJV: eat, have, be partaker, receive, take.

μεταλλασσω.def: from μετά (G3326) and ἀλλάσσω (G236); to exchange. KJV: change.

μεταμελλομαι.def: from μετά (G3326) and the middle voice of μέλω (G3199); to care afterwards, i.e. regret. KJV: repent (self).

μεταμορφοω.def: from μετά (G3326) and μορφόω (G3445); to transform (literally or figuratively, "metamorphose"). KJV: change, transfigure, transform.

μετανοεω.def: from μετά (G3326) and νοιέω (G3539); to think differently or afterwards, i.e. reconsider (morally, feel compunction). KJV: repent.

μετανοια.def: from μετανοέω (G3340); (subjectively) compunction (for guilt, including reformation); by implication, reversal (of (another's) decision). KJV: repentance.

μεταξυ.def: from μετά (G3326) and a form of σύν (G4862); betwixt (of place or person); (of time) as adjective, intervening, or (by implication) adjoining. KJV: between, mean while, next.

μεταπεμπω.def: from μετά (G3326) and πέμπω (G3992); to send from elsewhere, i.e. (middle voice) to summon or invite. KJV: call (send) for.

μεταστρεφω.def: from μετά (G3326) and στρέφω (G4762); to turn across, i.e. transmute or (figuratively) corrupt. KJV: pervert, turn.

μετασχηματιζω.def: from μετά (G3326) and a derivative of σχῆμα (G4976); to transfigure or disguise; figuratively, to apply (by accommodation). KJV: transfer, transform (self).

μετατιθημι.def: from μετά (G3326) and τίθημι (G5087); to transfer, i.e. (literally) transport, (by implication) exchange, (reflexively) change sides, or (figuratively) pervert. KJV: carry over, change, remove, translate, turn.

μετεπειτα.def: from μετά (G3326) and ἔπειτα (G1899); thereafter. KJV: afterward.

μετεχω.def: from μετά (G3326) and ἔχω (G2192); to share or participate; by implication, belong to, eat (or drink). KJV: be partaker, pertain, take part, use.

μετεωριζω.def: from a compound of μετά (G3326) and a collateral form of αἴρω (G142) or perhaps rather ἀήρ (G109) (compare "meteor"); to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively) suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious). KJV: be of doubtful mind.

μετοικεσια.def: from a derivative of a compound of μετά (G3326) and οἶκος (G3624); a change of abode, i.e. (specially), expatriation. KJV: X brought, carried(-ying) away (in-)to.

μετοικιζω.def: from the same as μετοικεσία (G3350); to transfer as a settler or captive, i.e colonize or exile. KJV: carry away, remove into.

μετοχη.def: from μετέχω (G3348); participation, i.e. intercourse. KJV: fellowship.

μετοχοσ.def: from μετέχω (G3348); participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate. KJV: fellow, partaker, partner.

μετρεω.def: from μέτρον (G3358); to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule). KJV: figuratively, to estimate:--measure, mete.

μετρητησ.def: from μετρέω (G3354); a measurer, i.e. (specially), a certain standard measure of capacity for liquids. KJV: firkin.

μετριοπαθεω.def: from a compound of the base of μετρίως (G3357) and πάθος (G3806); to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently). KJV: have compassion.

μετριωσ.def: adverb from a derivative of μέτρον (G3358); moderately, i.e. slightly. KJV: a little.

μετρον.def: an apparently primary word; a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree). KJV: measure.

μετωπον.def: from μετά (G3326) and ops (the face); the forehead (as opposite the countenance). KJV: forehead.

μεχρι.def: from μῆκος (G3372); as far as, i.e. up to a certain point (as a preposition, of extent (denoting the terminus, whereas ἄχρι (G891) refers especially to the space of time or place intervening) or conjunction). KJV: till, (un-)to, until.

μη.def: a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas οὐ (G3756) expresses an absolute denial); (adverb) not, (conjunction) lest; also (as an interrogative implying a negative answer (whereas οὐ (G3756) expects an affirmative one)) whether. KJV: any but (that), X forbear, + God forbid, + lack, lest, neither, never, no (X wise in), none, nor, (can-)not, nothing, that not, un(-taken), without.

μηδαμωσ.def: adverb from a compound of μή (G3361) and ἀμός (somebody); by no means. KJV: not so.

μηδε.def: from μή (G3361) and δέ (G1161); but not, not even; in a continued negation, nor. KJV: neither, nor (yet), (no) not (once, so much as).

μηδεισ.def: from μή (G3361) and εἷς (G1520); not even one (man, woman, thing). KJV: any (man, thing), no (man), none, not (at all, any man, a whit), nothing, + without delay.

μηδεποτε.def: from μηδέ (G3366) and ποτέ (G4218); not even ever. KJV: never.

μηδεπω.def: from μηδέ (G3366) and -πω (G4452); not even yet. KJV: not yet.

μηδοσ.def: of foreign origin (compare H4074); a Median, or inhabitant of Media. KJV: Mede.

μηκετι.def: from μή (G3361) and ἔτι (G2089); no further. KJV: any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more.

μηκοσ.def: probably akin to μέγας (G3173); length (literally or figuratively) length.

μηκυνω.def: from μῆκος (G3372); to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge. KJV: grow up.

μηλωτη.def: from μῆλον (a sheep); a sheep-skin. KJV: sheepskin.

μην.def: a stronger form of μέν (G3303); a particle of affirmation (only with ἦ (G2229)); assuredly. KJV: + surely.
a primary word; a month. KJV: month.

μηνυω.def: probably from the same base as μασσάομαι (G3145) and μνάομαι (G3415) (i.e. μάω, to strive); to disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind), i.e. report, declare, intimate. KJV: shew, tell.

μηουκ.def: i.e. μή (G3361) and οὐ (G3756); as interrogative and negative, is it not that?. KJV: neither (followed by no), + never, not.

μηποτε.def: from μή (G3361) and ποτέ (G4218); not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps). KJV: if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not.

μηπω.def: from μή (G3361) and -πω (G4452); not yet. KJV: not yet.

μηπωσ.def: from μή (G3361) and -πώς (G4458); lest somehow. KJV: lest (by any means, by some means, haply, perhaps).

μηροσ.def: perhaps a primary word; a thigh. KJV: thigh.

μητε.def: from μή (G3361) and τέ (G5037); not too, i.e. (in continued negation) neither or nor; also, not even. KJV: neither, (n-)or, so as much.

μητηρ.def: apparently a primary word; a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote). KJV: mother.

μητι.def: from μή (G3361) and the neuter of τὶς (G5100); whether at all. KJV: not (the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question).

μητιγε.def: from μήτι (G3385) and γέ (G1065); not at all then, i.e. not to say (the rather still). KJV: how much more.

μητισ.def: from μή (G3361) and τὶς (G5100); whether any. KJV: any (sometimes unexpressed except by the simple interrogative form of the sentence).

μητρα.def: from μήτηρ (G3384); the matrix. KJV: womb.

μητραλωασ.def: from μήτηρ (G3384) and the base of ἅλων (G257); a mother-thresher, i.e. matricide. KJV: murderer of mothers.

μητροπολισ.def: from μήτηρ (G3384) and πόλις (G4172); a mother city, i.e. "metropolis". KJV: chiefest city.

μια.def: irregular feminine of εἷς (G1520); one or first. KJV: a (certain), + agree, first, one, X other.

μιαινω.def: perhaps a primary verb; to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate (ceremonially or morally). KJV: defile.

μιασμα.def: from μιαίνω (G3392) ("miasma"); (morally) foulness (properly, the effect). KJV: pollution.

μιασμοσ.def: from μιαίνω (G3392); (morally) contamination (properly, the act). KJV: uncleanness.

μιγμα.def: from μίγνυμι (G3396); a compound. KJV: mixture.

μιγνυμι.def: a primary verb; to mix. KJV: mingle.

μικρον.def: masculine or neuter singular of μικρός (G3398) (as noun); a small space of time or degree. KJV: a (little) (while).

μικροσ.def: apparently a primary word; small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity). KJV: least, less, little, small.

μιλητοσ.def: of uncertain origin; Miletus, a city of Asia Minor. KJV: Miletus.

μιλιον.def: of Latin origin; a thousand paces, i.e. a "mile". KJV: mile.

μιμεομαι.def: middle voice from μῖμος (a "mimic"); to imitate. KJV: follow.

μιμητησ.def: from μιμέομαι (G3401); an imitator. KJV: follower.

μιμνησκω.def: a prolonged form of μνάομαι (G3415) (from which some of the tenses are borrowed); to remind, i.e. (middle voice) to recall to mind. KJV: be mindful, remember.

μισεω.def: from a primary μῖσος (hatred); to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less. KJV: hate(-ful).

μισθαποδοσια.def: from μισθαποδότης (G3406); requital (good or bad). KJV: recompence of reward.

μισθαποδοτησ.def: from μισθόω (G3409) and ἀποδίδωμι (G591); a renumerator. KJV: rewarder.

μισθιοσ.def: from μισθός (G3408); a wage-earner. KJV: hired servant.

μισθοσ.def: apparently a primary word; pay for service (literally or figuratively), good or bad. KJV: hire, reward, wages.

μισθοω.def: from μισθός (G3408); to let out for wages, i.e. (middle voice) to hire. KJV: hire.

μισθωμα.def: from μισθόω (G3409); a rented building. KJV: hired house.

μισθωτοσ.def: from μισθόω (G3409); a wage-worker (good or bad). KJV: hired servant, hireling.

μιτυληνη.def: for μυτιλήνη (abounding in shellfish); Mitylene (or Mytilene), a town on the island of Lesbos. KJV: Mitylene.

μιχαηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4317); Michael, an archangel. KJV: Michael.

μνα.def: of Latin origin; a mna (i.e. mina), a certain weight. KJV: pound.

μναομαι.def: middle voice of a derivative of μένω (G3306) or perhaps of the base of μασσάομαι (G3145) (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp); to bear in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish. KJV: be mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance.

μνασων.def: of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian. KJV: Mnason.

μνεια.def: from μνάομαι (G3415) or μιμνήσκω (G3403); recollection; by implication, recital. KJV: mention, remembrance.

μνημα.def: from μνάομαι (G3415); a memorial, i.e. sepulchral monument (burial-place). KJV: grave, sepulchre, tomb.

μνημειον.def: from μνήμη (G3420); a remembrance, i.e. cenotaph (place of interment). KJV: grave, sepulchre, tomb.

μνημονευω.def: from a derivative of μνήμη (G3420); to exercise memory, i.e. recollect; by implication, to punish; also to rehearse. KJV: make mention; be mindful, remember.

μνημοσυνον.def: from μνημονεύω (G3421); a reminder (memorandum), i.e. record. KJV: memorial.

μνηστευω.def: from a derivative of μνάομαι (G3415); to give a souvenir (engagement present), i.e. betroth. KJV: espouse.

μογιλαλοσ.def: from μόγις (G3425) and λαλέω (G2980); hardly talking, i.e. dumb (tongue-tied). KJV: having an impediment in his speech.

μογισ.def: adverb from a primary μόγος (toil); with difficulty. KJV: hardly.

μοδιοσ.def: of Latin origin; a modius, i.e. certain measure for things dry (the quantity or the utensil). KJV: bushel.

μοι.def: the simpler form of ἐμοί (G1698); to me. KJV: I, me, mine, my.

μοιχαλισ.def: a prolonged form of the feminine of μοιχός (G3432); an adulteress (literally or figuratively). KJV: adulteress(-ous, -y).

μοιχαω.def: from μοιχός (G3432); (middle voice) to commit adultery. KJV: commit adultery.

μοιχευω.def: from μοιχός (G3432); to commit adultery. KJV: commit adultery.

μοιχοσ.def: perhaps a primary word; a (male) paramour; figuratively, apostate. KJV: adulterer.

μολισ.def: probably by variation for μόγις (G3425); with difficulty. KJV: hardly, scarce(-ly), + with much work.

μολοχ.def: of Hebrew origin (H4432); Moloch (i.e. Molek), an idol. KJV: Moloch.

μολυνω.def: probably from μέλας (G3189); to soil (figuratively). KJV: defile.

μολυσμοσ.def: from μολύνω (G3435); a stain; i.e. (figuratively) immorality. KJV: filthiness.

μομφη.def: from μέμφομαι (G3201); blame, i.e. (by implication), a fault. KJV: quarrel.

μονη.def: from μένω (G3306); a staying, i.e. residence (the act or the place). KJV: abode, mansion.

μονογενησ.def: from μόνος (G3441) and γίνομαι (G1096); only-born, i.e. sole. KJV: only (begotten, child).

μονον.def: neuter of μόνος (G3441) as adverb; merely. KJV: alone, but, only.

μονοσ.def: probably from μένω (G3306); remaining, i.e. sole or single; by implication, mere. KJV: alone, only, by themselves.

μονοφθαλμοσ.def: from μόνος (G3441) and ὀφθαλμός (G3788); one-eyed. KJV: with one eye.

μονοω.def: from μόνος (G3441); to isolate, i.e. bereave. KJV: be desolate.

μορφη.def: perhaps from the base of μέρος (G3313) (through the idea of adjustment of parts); shape; figuratively, nature. KJV: form.

μορφοω.def: from the same as μορφή (G3444); to fashion (figuratively). KJV: form.

μορφωσισ.def: from μορφόω (G3445); formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula). KJV: form.

μοσχοποιεω.def: from μόσχος (G3448) and ποιέω (G4160); to fabricate the image of a bullock. KJV: make a calf.

μοσχοσ.def: probably strengthened for όσχος (a shoot); a young bullock. KJV: calf.

μου.def: the simpler form of ἐμοῦ (G1700); of me. KJV: I, me, mine (own), my.

μουσικοσ.def: from Μοῦσα (a Muse); "musical", i.e. (as noun) a minstrel. KJV: musician.

μοχθοσ.def: from the base of μόγις (G3425); toil, i.e. (by implication) sadness. KJV: painfulness, travail.

μυελοσ.def: perhaps a primary word; the marrow. KJV: marrow.

μυεω.def: from the base of μυστήριον (G3466); to initiate, i.e. (by implication) to teach. KJV: instruct.

μυθοσ.def: perhaps from the same as μυέω (G3453) (through the idea of tuition); a tale, i.e. fiction ("myth"). KJV: fable.

μυκαομαι.def: from a presumed derivative of μύζω (to "moo"); to bellow (roar). KJV: roar.

μυκτηριζω.def: from a derivative of the base of μυκάομαι (G3455) (meaning snout, as that whence lowing proceeds); to make mouths at, i.e. ridicule. KJV: mock.

μυλικοσ.def: from μύλος (G3458); belonging to a mill. KJV: mill(-stone).

μυλοσ.def: probably ultimately from the base of μόλις (G3433) (through the idea of hardship); a "mill", i.e. (by implication), a grinder (millstone). KJV: millstone.

μυλων.def: from μύλος (G3458); a mill-house. KJV: mill.

μυρα.def: of uncertain derivation; Myra, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Myra.

μυριασ.def: from μύριοι (G3463); a ten-thousand; by extension, a "myriad" or indefinite number. KJV: ten thousand.

μυριζω.def: from μύρον (G3464); to apply (perfumed) unguent to. KJV: anoint.

μυριοι.def: plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many); ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many. KJV: ten thousand.

μυρον.def: probably of foreign origin (compare H4753, σμύρνα (G4666)); "myrrh", i.e. (by implication) perfumed oil. KJV: ointment.

μυσια.def: of uncertain origin; Mysia, a region of Asia Minor. KJV: Mysia.

μυστηριον.def: from a derivative of μύω (to shut the mouth); a secret or "mystery" (through the idea of silence imposed by initiation into religious rites). KJV: mystery.

μυωπαζω.def: from a compound of the base of μυστήριον (G3466) and ὤψ (the face; from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700)); to shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly). KJV: cannot see far off.

μωλωψ.def: from μῶλος ("moil"; probably akin to the base of μόλις (G3433)) and probably ὤψ (the face; from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700)); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark. KJV: stripe.

μωμαομαι.def: from μῶμος (G3470); to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit). KJV: blame.

μωμοσ.def: perhaps from μέμφομαι (G3201); a flaw or blot, i.e. (figuratively) disgraceful person. KJV: blemish.

μωραινω.def: from μωρός (G3474); to become insipid; figuratively, to make (passively, act) as a simpleton. KJV: become fool, make foolish, lose savour.

μωρια.def: from μωρός (G3474); silliness, i.e. absurdity. KJV: foolishness.

μωρολογια.def: from a compound of μωρός (G3474) and λέγω (G3004); silly talk, i.e. buffoonery. KJV: foolish talking.

μωροσ.def: probably from the base of μυστήριον (G3466); dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e. heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd. KJV: fool(-ish, X -ishness).

μωσευσ.def: of Hebrew origin; (H4872); Moseus, Moses, or Mouses (i.e. Mosheh), the Hebrew lawgiver. KJV: Moses.
